title: Fails after the April 10th 2024 update
body: Thank you for the great app, but unfortunately it doesn’t work after the yesterday’s update. Can’t wait to use it again when it will be fixed.
author: Roman Klimenko

title: The best I habit overview
body: A bit pricy - but nice to support an indie developer. I have tried a lot of habit trackers and this is easy to tick and provide a nice overview.
author: asbj01rn

title: Super god app
body: Kan alt det den skal kunne på nær måske at man kan have en habit hver anden dag.
author: :DDDDDDDDDDD:

title: Love it
body:
Really simpel app - but it works good for me. 
I love that you see your progress in days, week and year - it keep me motivated. And i love that you Can write notes to the days you complet.
author: morgendug
